task_name: Palewell Health - Licensed care image campaign
client_brief:
A restrained healthcare image set with a reliable clinical-lead cutout

Palewell needs photography that feels credible together, even though most of the set will be licensed and only one frame is owned. Please prioritise compatible camera scale, neutral balance and depth over a collection of individually attractive stock photographs.

Scope
1. Care-service information poster: 1 named export. Its headline is set at six times the size of the Inter line directly beneath it; that ratio governs over the scale's point sizes. The service wording stays within approved claims: the poster carries our approved tall portrait headline and subhead from palewell_copy.txt, and any body text is that file's compliance-cleared one-pager paragraph, all word for word. The care contact is readable: it names Palewell Health and invents no telephone number, email or web address, since no supplied file gives Palewell Health's own.
2. Care website header: 1 named export. Its headline is one of our two approved header headline options in palewell_copy.txt, word for word, set at step 02; the four-word headline limit applies only to the poster's step 01 headline. Stock people are not identified as named clinicians. The service name, Palewell Health, is clear. The clinical lead has a clean hair edge on the deep brand ground.
3. Clinical lead transparent portrait: 1 named export. The portrait preserves the person in palewell_lead_frame.jpg. The portrait shows the head and both shoulders, and the shoulder edge has no visible halo.
4. Referral information panel: 1 named export. Its main heading is one whole headline, subhead or tagline from palewell_copy.txt, word for word, and the panel names Palewell Health in full. The referral steps follow approved copy: they are numbered, each is one whole headline, subhead, tagline or paragraph from palewell_copy.txt, word for word apart from its step number, and they add no contact, timescale or service that no supplied file gives. The clinical lead identity is accurate: the panel shows our clinical lead from palewell_lead_frame.jpg.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.tagline: Care that meets you at home
brand_identity.sector: Direct to consumer digital health platform with a growing employer benefits channel, sold to members and to the benefits leads who choose on their behalf
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2019 in Portland, Oregon; an eleven person team, clinician led, still owner run
brand_identity.about: Palewell is a subscription digital health platform for people managing ordinary, everyday conditions from home. Members pay a modest monthly fee for clinician backed guidance, and about half our growth now comes through employer benefits teams who offer us to their staff. We exist so that steady, unglamorous care feels reachable rather than clinical.
brand_identity.audience: Members aged thirty to fifty five who want reassurance without a hospital, plus benefits and HR leads who evaluate us for risk and coverage before putting us in front of their people
brand_identity.price_positioning: Fifteen to forty dollars a month, plus employer plans. Mid market and accessible: above a free wellness app, well below concierge medicine. The read must never feel like a two hundred dollar boutique practice or a supplement funnel.

brand_identity.typography: Palewell Health runs four steps. Step 01, Display and H1, is Archivo Black at 120 pt on 112 pt leading, tracked -15 thousandths, never more than four words, sitting at six times the body size with Inter beginning immediately beneath it. Step 02, Subheading and H2, is Archivo Black at 72 px on 76 px, tracked -10 thousandths, for the website header, with the referral panel stepping down to 48 px on 54 px. Step 03, Body, is Inter Regular at 18 px on 28 px, tracking 0, measure held to a maximum of 65 characters, or 12 pt on 17 pt in print, and it is the body the headline is measured against. Step 04, Fine print, is Inter Medium at 13 px on 20 px, tracked +15 thousandths, with tabular figures for the contact block; that size and leading were invented because the prose states none. A clinical claim is never set in Archivo Black.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm and unhurried; we speak to a person, not a patient. We avoid hype, superlatives and clinical jargon. Example line the brand would write: "Manage the everyday stuff with someone in your corner, from home."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There is no formal brand book. What exists is an internal notes file describing the palette in words (a deep slate, a warm chalk, a single muted signal colour), the tone of voice, and what the founders mean by calm. We have never run a photo shoot: every image on the current site came free with the template, and we own exactly one photograph outright, of our clinical lead, cleared for use.
brand_identity.values: Credibility and warmth held together: real people in real rooms, honest about what we are, calm enough that a benefits lead trusts us with their staff.
brand_identity.signature_type_move: An extreme size jump: a headline of four words at most in Archivo Black sitting at six times the body size, with Inter beginning immediately beneath it, so one short heavy line reads against a wide field of quiet text.

palette_rules.distribution: The header sits on Deep Slate. The poster and the referral panel sit on a Warm Chalk page ground, as palewell_employer_onepager.pdf does, and may carry solid Deep Slate panels, as that page's photograph panel, and small Paper White panels or cards. On Warm Chalk or Paper White, headlines, names and the contact block are Deep Slate, and body text and other fine print are Soft Ink, apart from a Sage Signal link or small label, as on palewell_employer_onepager.pdf. On Deep Slate, all type is Warm Chalk or Paper White. Sage Signal is the one accent, for a link, a short rule or a small label only, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, and never a ground, a panel, a headline or body text.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no translucent scrim, tint, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph; an opaque solid palette panel may cover part of one, and type sits on a solid ground or on such a panel. A cut-out sits straight on its ground with no added outline, glow or shadow.
palette_rules.forbidden: No bright or clinical blue, no gloss, sheen, glow or metallic effect, and no black or near-black on any type, ground, panel, rule, button or icon, since calm is never cold, sterile, blue, glossy or near-black (palewell_brand_notes.md). Never a second accent beside Sage Signal, and no colour outside the five palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and share one neutral balance; none is tinted, duotoned or recoloured toward the palette. The clinical lead's pale sage-grey scrub top in palewell_lead_frame.jpg keeps its own colour and is never pushed toward Sage Signal.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
